Mission Local reported that MEDA was purchasing a four-story, 1914 brick building at 2901 16th St. to convert into 62 permanently affordable homes. The building is two blocks east of 16th Street BART; its ground floor has hair salons and restaurants, and tenants could stay during rehabilitation or move out.
